title: Emitter2D · GUI Particles
description: Built-in Emitter2D workflow for Roblox UI particles, bursts, flipbooks and 3D-to-2D conversion. Uses the installed dogwarrior24 plugin (9544897050), observed attribute encoding, real client BindableEvents and a bounded read-only inspector. UI/GUI/2D частицы и конфетти. No bundled plugin/runtime or private API.
steps: Read elio_skills action read id builtin-emitter2d, then references/workflow.md and runtime-contract.md. Respect exclusions and explicit alternative-plugin choices.

Inspect Studio mode, exact GUI/export and installed runtime using the documented helper; use plugin_list/plugin_inspect only when listed. Read-only UI filtering is not a plugin click, library search or import.

Read scripts/inspect_emitter.luau. Preserve ClassName/Version, actual attribute types, ancestor UI and controllers. Author only documented settings on owned/approved copies; runtime changes require a reviewed actual client contract.

Play-test on Client, measure bounded particles and cleanup/respawn, preserve the camera/UI and report pending live checks. Never install/update/enable permissions or change Server Authority settings silently.
pitfalls: Install Client is required for in-game playback and after plugin updates; a Studio preview does not prove client installation. Do not invent runtime paths, require unknown code, or redistribute plugin/client source.

Author reports Next Generation Replication / Server Authority incompatibility. UI particles are slower than native 3D particles. Size is NumberRange, Scale is NumberSequence, LifeTime spelling is significant; actual stored attribute encoding must be inspected.
verification: Run routing/migration/resource-boundary tests and actual Luau inspector fixtures. These do not prove the installed plugin or in-game appearance.
Live plugin create/convert, actual Client runtime, sizing/clipping/ZIndex, mobile load, cleanup and visual acceptance require the user PC.
